specs.title: [R-UI-10] / with an empty form
[R-UI-10] / after a success
[R-UI-10] / after an error
[R-UI-10] / with a delete confirmation revealed
[R-UI-10] /links/{code} for each days link
[R-UI-10] /links/{unknown}
[R-UI-1] form has the Destination URL and Custom alias (optional) textboxes and a Shorten button, with no constraint validation
[R-UI-2] destination: bare host gets https://
[R-UI-2] destination: bare host and path gets https://
[R-UI-2] destination: an explicit upper-case scheme is sent unchanged
[R-UI-2] destination: host:port without a scheme gets https://
[R-UI-2] destination: surrounding ASCII whitespace is trimmed
[R-UI-2] the alias field is trimmed; a whitespace-only alias is omitted (generated code)
[R-UI-3] success shows a status with a link to the shortUrl and a working "Copy short link" button
[R-UI-4] API error (invalid alias) shows exactly the invalid_alias message in an alert
[R-UI-4] API error (reserved alias (mixed case)) shows exactly the alias_reserved message in an alert
[R-UI-4] API error (unsupported scheme) shows exactly the invalid_url message in an alert
[R-UI-4] API error (URL over 2048 code points) shows exactly the invalid_url message in an alert
[R-UI-4] taken alias shows exactly the alias_taken message
[R-UI-5] "Your links" table: exactly one header row with Short link, Destination, Clicks, Created
[R-UI-5] the table lists the 20 newest links in API order
[R-UI-5] row cells: shortUrl link, url, clickCount as a plain integer, createdAt as UTC YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM; Stats and Delete controls
[R-UI-5][gray-box] Clicks has no thousands separator and Created truncates seconds (hh:mm:59.9 is not rounded up)
[R-UI-5] after a successful create the table is re-fetched without a full page reload
[R-UI-6] Delete reveals "Confirm delete" in the same row; only one open at a time; nothing deleted until confirmed
[R-UI-12] an empty or whitespace-only destination shows the invalid_url alert; submitting causes no navigation and no non-GET/HEAD request
[R-UI-11] a full create -> stats -> delete -> error journey sends no browser request to /api/
[R-UI-7] heading, totals and the four tables match the API stats (default window)
[R-UI-7] a link with no clicks: zero totals and breakdown tables with a header row and no body rows
[R-UI-7][gray-box] totals are base-10 integers without separators
[R-UI-8] the 7/30/90 days links set ?days= and the matching one has aria-current="page"
[R-UI-8] a valid days without a link is honored (1 and 365) and no link is current
[R-UI-8] missing or invalid days behaves exactly like days=30, including aria-current on "30 days"
